cards.subtitle: Streaming real agent events into the pixel village.
cards.statusLine: CONSENSUS · ONE EVENT SHAPE, CARDS AS FALLBACK

script.speaker: introducer
script.text: SSE channel open — backend agent events flow into the village.

script.speaker: gemini
script.text: Mapping each event to a villager line: speaker, text, consensus.

script.speaker: band
script.text: Raw events arrive out of order. Bubbles fire over each other.

script.speaker: introducer
script.text: Buffering per round — lines queue and play in sequence.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Consensus meter only climbs, live or scripted. Enforced.

script.speaker: band
script.text: Dropped stream falls back to phase cards without a flicker.

script.speaker: introducer
script.text: Village breathes on real events. Wired.

cards.subtitle: Gluing backend, graph, and loop into one story.
cards.statusLine: CONSENSUS · ONE CLOCK DRIVES EVERY PANE

script.speaker: introducer
script.text: Three feeds: /profile events, graph payloads, loop generations.

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: Graph re-clusters the moment loop weights arrive. Wired direct.

script.speaker: band
script.text: Village lags the graph — the reweight lands before the argument.

script.speaker: introducer
script.text: One shared round clock now gates village, graph, and meter.

script.speaker: gemini
script.text: Rationale text matches across panes — same string everywhere.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: End-to-end run: profile in, graph moves, 41% → 84% on cue.

script.speaker: introducer
script.text: The three panes tell one story. Integrated.

cards.subtitle: Locking a deterministic run for the stage.
cards.statusLine: CONSENSUS · REPLAY IS FRAME-EXACT, LIVE IS BACKUP

script.speaker: band
script.text: Recorded the best full run — every event, timestamped.

script.speaker: introducer
script.text: Replay pipes it through the same SSE path. No code forks.

script.speaker: gemini
script.text: Live mode on stage would show it's real, not canned.

script.speaker: introducer
script.text: Live stays one keypress away. Replay is the default open.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Three replays, identical frames, meter ends at 84% each time.

script.speaker: band
script.text: Openers render at the finale — BAND intro caps the run.

script.speaker: introducer
script.text: Demo frozen. Kindred is ready for the stage.
